init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for multi-GPU multi-node SLURM jobs with NCCL backend and communication groups
PCA_train_and_apply: train a PCA model on a covariance matrix and apply dimensionality reduction with optional whitening to numpy or torch data
normalize_data: normalize numpy arrays or PyTorch tensors by dividing each row by its L2 norm
restart_from_checkpoint: restart a training run by loading model state dicts and run variables from a PyTorch checkpoint file
AverageMeter_track_metrics: create an AverageMeter to track running averages of training metrics like loss or accuracy across batches
